headline: Delhi government proposes adding alcohol and tobacco to deposit return system
hook: Deposit scheme may raise sin goods costs

modes.bear: The added deposit will likely raise consumer prices, squeezing demand for alcohol and tobacco products.
modes.bull: The scheme could spur growth in the recycling sector and create new jobs, offsetting costs for producers.
modes.simple: Delhi will require a small refundable deposit on alcohol and tobacco purchases to promote recycling, which may increase prices and affect sales.

summary: The Delhi government announced plans to include alcohol and tobacco products in a proposed deposit‑return scheme. The move aims to encourage recycling and curb waste from these 'sin goods'. Retailers and consumers of liquor and cigarettes will have to pay a refundable deposit at purchase. Investors should note potential price impacts on Indian alcohol and tobacco companies.
why_it_matters: Higher prices for alcohol and tobacco

headline: VST Industries announces change in corporate office of RTA KFin Technologies
hook: New address for RTA operations in 2026
summary: VST Industries has informed the stock exchange that its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies, will shift its corporate office location. The change becomes effective from December 1, 2026. This is a routine administrative update regarding shareholder services and record-keeping. Retail investors holding shares in VST Industries face no direct financial impact from this procedural relocation.
whats_next: December 1, 2026 effective date for RTA office change
why_it_matters: Routine administrative update with zero impact on share value.
